body: Probed fork availability directly rather than trusting SPEC section 2.1's claim, per the SPEC's own section 5.4 prohibition on cached capability statements. Four observations, all from this desktop session (entrypoint claude-desktop, app 1.52386.3, claude-code 2.1.266).U+000AU+000A1U+002E A dispatch with `subagent_type: "fork"` returns `Agent type 'fork' not found`, followed by the roster of 20 available types. A hard error, not a degraded fallback.U+000A2U+002E A bounded `strings` sweep of the claude binary returns exactly two matching symbols: `isForkSubagentEnabled` and `tengu_fork_subagent_enabled`. The `tengu_` prefix is the internal feature-gate namespace, so availability is a server-side flag rather than a check on entrypoint.U+000A3U+002E No `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT` in the environment, no `fork` key in any settings file, and no `~/.claude/statsig` directory holding a gate value. There is no local override in either direction.U+000A4U+002E `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=claude-desktop` is set, consistent with the SPEC, but it is correlation across two surfaces rather than the mechanism.U+000AU+000AU+002A*This corrects SPEC section 2.1, which frames availability as entrypoint-derived.** The practical difference is that the flag can move without a release or a config change, in either direction, so nothing that reads as configuration can depend on it.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Fork's actual footprint in the SPEC is one sentence.** Section 5.3's final paragraph is the only load-bearing use. Section 3.2 uses fork as a foil - the three things it cannot do (worktree, model pin, tool restriction) are what justify `machinist` existing, and that argument holds whether or not fork is reachable. Sections 2 C4, 2.1 and 10.4 are documentation. Removing fork therefore costs one sentence.U+000AU+000AU+002A*The cell fork fills is narrow because of the other deletions.** `machinist` requires a fully-specified brief - its entry invariant halts unless the brief names every file - and fork has no worktree, so maker work was never forkable. The work that genuinely wanted fork belonged to `architect`, `investigator` and `delivery-lead`, all three deleted, all three returning to main by design.U+000AU+000AThree options were put to the user: (A) two vehicles, never name fork, parity structural; (B) SPEC as written, fork where available, parity advisory only; (C) runtime self-test and branch, which is the class-A layer section 11 refuses to add. A was recommended. **No selection has been made yet** - the user was asked and has not answered, so no decision is recorded.U+000AU+000ABoth risks written to the spine in the same turn: the corrected gate mechanism, and the honest cost of option A against section 1.3's primary objective.
